issues.description: The UML in the problem statement and the template indicate singFarmSongVerse is a private method of Farm, but the solution implements it as protected. This visibility difference is structural and may confuse students about the intended access level (and possibly affect tests that need to call the method).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the visibility consistent across artifacts. Either (a) change the solution's singFarmSongVerse back to private to match the UML/template, or (b) update the UML/problem statement and template to indicate protected (with an explanatory note if tests require package/subclass access). Choose the option that aligns with intended test access and document it in the problem statement.
